records.jp: うーん。<CR>太陽がまぶしーなー！
records.en_original: Ahh. The sun is so bright today!
records.en: Ahh. The sun is so bright today!

records.jp: ふふ。愛央、気持ちよさそうね
records.en_original: Hehe. You look comfortable, Ao.
records.en: Hehe. You look comfortable, Ao.

records.jp: うん。なんだかのんびりーって感じ？<CR>ちょっとぜいたくな気分かなー
records.en_original: Yeah. Doesn't it feel good to kick back and relax? You gotta treat yourself sometimes.
records.en: Yeah. Doesn't it feel good to kick back and relax? You gotta treat yourself sometimes.

records.jp: そうね。たまにはこういうのも<CR>良いかもしれないわね
records.en_original: You're right. This kind of thing might be nice every once in a while.
records.en: You're right. This kind of thing might be nice every once in a while.

records.jp: でしょでしょ？
records.en_original: For sure!
records.en: For sure!

records.jp: あ、でも美弦さん……<CR>全然くつろいだ顔してないような？
records.en_original: But, Mio... Are you okay? You don't look relaxed at all.
records.en: But, Mio-san... Are you okay? You don't look relaxed at all.

records.jp: こういう落ち着いた時間こそ、<CR>いろいろ考えを巡らせるのにちょうどよくて
records.en_original: Calm moments like these are perfect for me to ponder this and that.
records.en: Calm moments like these are perfect for me to ponder this and that.

records.jp: ダメダメ！　こういう時はちゃんと休まないと！
records.en_original: No no no! These moments are for resting!
records.en: No no no! These moments are for resting!

records.jp: ほら、ビーチチェアとかって、<CR>やっぱ夏ーって感じだし！
records.en_original: Yeah, sitting in a beach chair really makes it feel like summer!
records.en: Yeah, sitting in a beach chair really makes it feel like summer!

records.jp: といっても、この世界は見たところ、<CR>夏以外の季節はなさそうだけど
records.en_original: I'm not sure this world has any other seasons besides summer.
records.en: I'm not sure this world has any other seasons besides summer.

records.jp: もー、美弦さんはー。<CR>こーゆーのは気分が大事なんだから、いーの！
records.en_original: That's enough thinking, Mio! Just try to relax and enjoy this feeling!
records.en: That's enough thinking, Mio-san! Just try to relax and enjoy this feeling!

records.jp: それにさ、夏しかない世界って、<CR>それはそれで、楽しくない？
records.en_original: Besides, a world where summer never ends sounds fun, don't you think?
records.en: Besides, a world where summer never ends sounds fun, don't you think?

records.jp: ……そうね。<CR>それはそれで素敵かもしれないわね
records.en_original: ...Yes, I suppose that would be nice.
records.en: ...Yes, I suppose that would be nice.

records.jp: ……てことで、のんびりリラックスしよ？
records.en_original: So let's just relax, okay?
records.en: So let's just relax, okay?

records.jp: ええ
records.en_original: All right.
records.en: All right.

records.jp: ふう、陽射しが気持ちいい……
records.en_original: Ahh, the sun feels nice...
records.en: Ahh, the sun feels nice...

records.jp: でしょ？　やっと美弦さんも柔らかくなってきた
records.en_original: Doesn't it? You're finally starting to loosen up, Mio.
records.en: Doesn't it? You're finally starting to loosen up, Mio-san.

records.jp: 私ってそんなに堅いイメージがある？
records.en_original: Do I really seem so uptight to you?
records.en: Do I really seem so uptight to you?

records.jp: うーん……
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en: Hmm...

records.jp: 美弦さんて、私みたいにダラダラしてなそう。<CR>なんとなく、イメージ的にだけど
records.en_original: I can't imagine you ever lazing around like me. That's the impression I get, anyway.
records.en: Mio-san, you don't seem like the type to laze around like me. That's just the impression I get, though.

records.jp: そうね……そうかもしれない。<CR>何かしら、やるべきこともあるしね
records.en_original: Mm... You might be right about that. There's always just so much that has to be done.
records.en: Mm... You might be right about that. There's always just so much that has to be done.

records.jp: やっぱり真面目派だったー！
records.en_original: I knew you were the hardworking type!
records.en: I knew you were the hardworking type!

records.jp: クールなイメージだったから、<CR>こうふやけかけた姿はあんまり見たことがないかも
records.en_original: You're always so calm and composed. I don't think I've ever seen you relaxed like this.
records.en: You're always so calm and composed. I don't think I've ever seen you relaxed like this.

records.jp: そうね……確かに人前だと無意識にそうして<CR>しまうわね
records.en_original: You're right... I tend to act that way in front of people without thinking about it.
records.en: You're right... I tend to act that way in front of people without thinking about it.

records.jp: なるほど……
records.en_original: I see...
records.en: I see...

records.jp: あ……つまらない返事でごめんなさい。<CR>あまり面白みのない性格なのよね
records.en_original: Sorry, that's a bit of a boring answer... I'm not the most interesting person.
records.en: Sorry, that's a bit of a boring answer... I'm not the most interesting person.

records.jp: そんな！　やっぱ美弦さんってすごいなぁ。<CR>私はつい、ダラダラが一番だなって。たはは
records.en_original: That's not true! You're amazing, Mio! All I ever think about is laying around doing nothing. Haha!
records.en: That's not true! You're amazing, Mio-san! All I ever think about is laying around doing nothing. Haha!

records.jp: あ！　なんか喉渇いちゃった！<CR>何か飲みましょう！
records.en_original: Ah! I'm thirsty! Let's get something to drink!
records.en: Ah! I'm thirsty! Let's get something to drink!

records.jp: ええ。私もそう思ってたところ。<CR>愛央は何にするの？
records.en_original: Yes, I was just thinking the same thing. What would you like, Ao?
records.en: Yes, I was just thinking the same thing. What would you like, Ao?

records.jp: えっと……
records.en_original: Um...
records.en: Um...

records.jp: フルーツジュースにしようかな。<CR>トロピカルっぽくて、ビーチに似合うし！
records.en_original: Maybe I'll have some juice. Something tropical to enjoy on the beach!
records.en: Maybe I'll have some juice. Something tropical to enjoy on the beach!

records.jp: たとえばりんごジュースでもトロピカルなの？<CR>熱帯の果物じゃないけど
records.en_original: How about apple juice? It's not really a tropical fruit, though.
records.en: How about apple juice? It's not really a tropical fruit, though.

records.jp: うーん。全然オッケー！<CR>なんていっても、気分の問題だし
records.en_original: No problem! At the end of the day, it's just about the vibe anyway.
records.en: No problem! At the end of the day, it's just about the vibe anyway.

records.jp: 気分の問題か……
records.en_original: It's just about the vibe...
records.en: It's just about the vibe...

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Hmm?
records.en: Hmm?

records.jp: それじゃ私も愛央と同じものにする。<CR>トロピカルな気分を楽しみましょう
records.en_original: In that case, I'll have the same thing. We can enjoy the tropical vibes together.
records.en: In that case, I'll have the same thing. We can enjoy the tropical vibes together.

records.jp: やったー！　お揃いー！
records.en_original: Yay! Twinsies!
records.en: Yay! Twinsies!

records.jp: 美弦さんと同じものにしようかな！
records.en_original: I'll have whatever you're having, Mio!
records.en: I'll have whatever you're having, Mio-san!

records.jp: 私と？
records.en_original: Me?
records.en: Me?

records.jp: ほら。お揃いってなんとなく<CR>仲良しな感じで楽しいし！
records.en_original: Yeah, we can be twinsies! That's what friends do!
records.en: Yeah, we can be twinsies! That's what friends do!

records.jp: じゃあ、カレー味
records.en_original: Then, how about a curry-flavored drink?
records.en: Then, how about a curry-flavored drink?

records.jp: えええっ！？　い、いくらカレー好きでも……<CR>それ絶対、かえってのど渇くやつだから！
records.en_original: Whaaat?! That would just make you even more thirsty, no matter how much you love curry!
records.en: Whaaat?! That would just make you even more thirsty, no matter how much you love curry!

records.jp: 冗談よ
records.en_original: I'm kidding.
records.en: I'm kidding.

records.jp: びっくりしたぁ。ていうか美弦さんだし<CR>冗談に聞こえなかった
records.en_original: You scared me! I wasn't expecting a joke from you, of all people.
records.en: You scared me! And because it was you, Mio-san, it didn't sound like a joke.

records.jp: うーん。セルフイメージを逆手に取った冗談……<CR>これ、使えるかしら
records.en_original: Hmmm. Subverting people's expectations of you as a joke... This might come in handy.
records.en: Hmmm. Subverting people's expectations of you as a joke... This might come in handy.

records.jp: 美弦さん！？　どこ目指してるわけ！？
records.en_original: Mio?! What are you getting at?!
records.en: Mio-san?! What are you getting at?!

records.jp: その……<CR>冗談くらい言えるようになりたくて
records.en_original: I just...wanted to know how to make a decent joke.
records.en: I just...wanted to know how to make a decent joke.

records.jp: （美弦さんって、実は可愛い！？）
records.en_original: (Mio is...actually kind of adorable?!)
records.en: (Mio-san is...actually kind of adorable?!)

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
